Kageaki"Now the concrete plan. First, the date and time..."
Kageaki"I hear there is to be a Noh performance tomorrow evening."
Ichijou"Noh...?"
Kageaki"Yes. Hosted by Doushin Yusa. Apparently they will use the main keep's Noh theater."
Ichijou"That big place?"
Kageaki"No outside guests, apparently; strictly an internal affair. In that case, quite a number of people from the castle will probably be invited."
Ichijou"Then that's our chance, no?"
Kageaki"If only it were that convenient. Kuniuji is bound to be invited too. And attacking the Noh performance would be a poor move. With Rokuhara's important people gathered there, security will naturally be tight."
Ichijou"..."
Kageaki"Afterward is what we should aim for. The moment it ends and the guards relax—"
